definition: to share a home as a couple
description: A mirror selfie in the dark green hallway of a small flat. A young woman with long dark hair in a mustard sweater and grey trousers holds up her phone while a young man in a white T-shirt hugs her from behind; both laugh and he leans his head against hers. Around them are stacked cardboard moving boxes, coats on the hooks, a bicycle against the wall and mugs on a shelf. A tabby cat walks across the herringbone wooden floor and stops beside them under a hanging lamp.

es.answer: Se están haciendo un selfi juntos en el espejo.
phrases: hacerse un selfi en el espejo
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la pareja?
